upstream_mechanism.causal_history: KirinEnv accumulates ball position, velocity and time history before prediction
upstream_mechanism.reference: predicted hit state is converted to a roll target and sigmoid joint reference
upstream_mechanism.timing: sigmoid center is set to predicted time minus 0.12 s

local_adaptation.predictor: existing causal drag-aware public-state intercept model
local_adaptation.profile: bounded Hermite contact prefix with measured qdot seed
